sana (Design): rough thread: proposing that permalinks always reveal the target in the left rail even if the containing group is collapsed. Thoughts?

leo (Frontend): +1. Auto-expand so the link isn't a dead end. Expand should be instant on load (no anim) and not add a history entry.

frank (PM): prefer clean URLs without UI flags. canonical path = resource path (e.g. /console/serving/pool-3). No ?open params.

maya (A11y): two accessibility rules: 1) move focus to the revealed item after expand, 2) announce the action via aria-live ("Opened Serving group. Focus moved to Pool 3").

sana (Design): breadcrumb behavior: breadcrumbs reflect resource hierarchy (ServedModel > Pool 3 > Settings) and should not depend on the visual grouping labels.

leo (Frontend): implementation note: route->target map, then expand clusters programmatically with replaceState so back button isn't filled with auto-actions. User toggles still pushState.

frank (PM): overlays (flyouts) should be legit routes: /models/shipper-7/settings opens overlay on load. If overlay opens, pushing state is OK so back closes it.

maya (A11y): keyboard guidance: Enter activates nav, Space toggles group. Document in the a11y guide. Also provide an initial off-screen helper for screen readers describing controls.

opsbot: FYI: infra maintenance tonight 01:00 UTC. No console schema changes during window.

sana (Design): decisions: 1) canonical routes do not encode collapsed state; 2) permalinks auto-open groups (instant, replaceState), focus target; 3) overlays are path-addressable and pushState; 4) a11y announcements + focus rules; 5) keyboard mapping: Enter=open, Space=toggle. I'll add these to the RFC and drop a prototype soon.

leo (Frontend): will upload route->cluster mapping and a tiny test harness.

maya (A11y): I'll review the wording of aria-live messages once the prototype is up.

sana (Design): great, thanks everyone :sparkles:
